source: kenyanstocks.com financial statements API (farmed, complete) | FY2025: The Co-operative Bank of Kenya Group audited results for the year ended 31 December 2025, the bank filing published on nse.co.ke and co-opbank.co.ke. | CRON r16 (2026-10-12): H1 2026 column taken from the own filing of the issuer, The Co-operative Bank of Kenya Group unaudited results for the period ended 30 June 2026, group column and not the bank-only column. Printed group figures, KShs thousands scaled to absolute KES: Total operating income 48,938,369; Total other operating expenses 26,258,916 (loan loss provision 3,727,871 plus staff costs 11,217,439 plus other); Profit before tax and exceptional items 22,679,453; Exceptional item share of profit of associate 377,943; Profit before tax 23,057,396; Current tax 5,285,437 less deferred tax 251,749 equals income tax 5,033,688; Profit after tax 18,023,708; basic earnings per share 3.08. Ties: total operating income less total other operating expenses equals 22,679,453, the printed profit before tax and exceptional items; plus the 377,943 associate share equals the printed profit before tax 23,057,396; profit before tax less income tax equals 18,023,708. The column previously stored BANK-only figures (total operating income 43,447,257; profit after tax 15,678,412; EPS 2.67) in the group row, and left operating expenses, income tax and the profit before tax row empty.
source_note: Farmed from the kenyanstocks.com statement API on 2026-09-21. Every cell is computed: line items carried from the source (0 where absent), group subtotals and statement totals computed by identity. No blanks. | Revenue FY2021 to FY2025 replaced with the issuer printed TOTAL OPERATING INCOME: the stored row was derived from income-side group totals and equalled NET INTEREST INCOME for FY2025 (62,850,762), understating the top line by all non-interest income. Cost of sales and gross profit do not apply to a bank. Operating Expenses FY2024 to FY2021 taken from the audited statements; the stored FY2024 and FY2023 amounts were 109,689 and 28,195 thousand higher than the audited comparatives. H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-coop-2026-ir-hy/): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.

reconciliation_note: Net Profit (computed) matches the source's period total on every period. Operating Profit (EBIT) less Net Finance Costs plus Other Income equals Profit Before Tax does not hold in FY2023, FY2022, FY2021: the statement bridges operating profit to profit before tax through further lines (Fee and Commission Expense; Fee and Commission Income; Net Fee and Commision Income; Net Fee and Commision Income Total; Interest and similar expense calculated using the effective interest method) and the file's own bridge reproduces the filed profit before tax; both figures are shown unchanged.

note: FY2025 column taken from the audited group statement of comprehensive income, KES thousands as printed. Rows were matched to the FY2024 comparatives printed in the same document (interest income 86,249,958; total other operating expenses 46,689,482; profit before tax 34,780,319 all reproduce the stored FY2024 values). Revenue stays empty for FY2025: this row is net interest income plus net fee and commission income, and the announcement prints no fee and commission expense line, so the construct cannot be reproduced without estimating. ROA and Debt to Equity are computed from the filed profit, total assets and total equity using the formula that reproduces the stored FY2024 values.
